heading: Definitions
lead: For the purposes of this part:

tree.heading: Asset response activity
tree.text: The term “asset response activity” means an activity to support an entity impacted by an incident with the response to, remediation of, or recovery from, the incident, including—

children.text: furnishing technical and advisory assistance to the entity to protect the assets of the entity, mitigate vulnerabilities, and reduce the related impacts;

assessing potential risks to the critical infrastructure sector or geographic region impacted by the incident, including potential cascading effects of the incident on other critical infrastructure sectors or geographic regions;
developing courses of action to mitigate the risks assessed under subparagraph (B);
facilitating information sharing and operational coordination with entities performing threat response activities; and
providing guidance on how best to use Federal resources and capabilities in a timely, effective manner to speed recovery from the incident.

tree.heading: Declaration
tree.text: The term “declaration” means a declaration of the Secretary under section 677b(a)(1) of this title.

tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency.

tree.heading: Federal agency
tree.text: The term “Federal agency” has the meaning given the term “agency” in section 3502 of title 44.

tree.heading: Fund
tree.text: The term “Fund” means the Cyber Response and Recovery Fund established under section 677c(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Incident
tree.text: The term “incident” has the meaning given the term in section 3552 of title 44.

tree.heading: Renewal
tree.text: The term “renewal” means a renewal of a declaration under section 677b(d) of this title.

children.text: means an incident or a group of related incidents that results, or is likely to result, in demonstrable harm to—
the national security interests, foreign relations, or economy of the United States; or
the public confidence, civil liberties, or public health and safety of the people of the United States; and
does not include an incident or a portion of a group of related incidents that occurs on—
a national security system (as defined in section 3552 of title 44); or
an information system described in paragraph (2) or (3) of section 3553(e) of title 44.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 107–296, title XXII, § 2232, as added Pub. L. 117–58, div. G, title VI, § 70602(a), Nov. 15, 2021, 135 Stat. 1267.)
